author: all5ac
quote: It's a masterpiece. I love the simplicity of these retro games. The limited pallet is where the dev gave this art design wings. Like molding a vase from clay, this game is a jewel no single frame can do justice. You just need to give it a try.

author: all5ac
quote: This game runs like it has malware. My game hard locked my PS5 Pro and popped up a gibberish error when I rebooted it. Up to that point I was not getting in to it. Slow paced, nausea inducing characters that are just way out of context for this series. This whole game has zero feel to it. The performance is crippling, input delay is unfathomably bad. This can't be happening right? There is just no way I refunded GTA VI.
